title: WooCommerce Theme Edits
meta: Change, fix or extend your store theme, from small layout edits to new shop templates. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WooCommerce theme edits for your shop pages
overview: Tell us what looks off in your store, or what you want to add, and we make the changes in a child theme so updates cannot undo them. We can adjust product pages, the cart and checkout styling, shop filters, headers and footers. We work on a staging copy where your host allows it, check orders still go through, and only then apply the changes to your live shop.

faq: Yes, because we put them in a child theme. The parent theme can update without wiping your changes, and we leave notes on where each edit lives.
Can you change how the checkout works?
We can restyle it and reorder fields. Deeper changes to checkout logic are a different job, and we flag them first because mistakes there can cost you orders.
Do you test that orders still work?
Always. After any change that touches the shop we place a test order, check emails and stock, and refund the test, so you know the path to payment is intact.
Which themes do you work with?
Storefront, Astra, Kadence, Flatsome, Woodmart, Divi and most block themes. For a rarely used theme, send us the name and we check it before quoting.
